text:
Recipes: Miso soup
material: Two spoons of soybean paste, tofu half hair, Half a zucchini, one onion, A handful of anchovies, two cloves of garlic, five cups of water.
Cooking method:
1. Wash the anchovies, put them in a pot, pour water, boil and make the soup..
2. Take out the anchovies and dissolve the soybean paste well..
3. Chop the tofu and vegetables nicely and boil them..
4. Add minced garlic and boil a little more to finish..

Recipes: kimchi soup
material: A bowl of ripe kimchi, tofu half hair, A handful of bean sprouts, Five cups of anchovy broth, Minced garlic, red pepper powder.
Cooking method:
1. Cut the kimchi into small pieces..
2. Add kimchi to anchovy broth and boil to bring out the sour taste..
3. Add tofu and bean sprouts, boil and skim off the foam..
4. Finish by seasoning with minced garlic and red pepper powder..

Recipes: Bibimbap
material: A bowl of white rice, spinach, bean sprouts, bellflower, fern, carrot, egg, Gochujang, sesame oil.
Cooking method:
1. Blanch each type of vegetable, season it and serve separately..
2. Place vegetables in matching colors on top of warm white rice..
3. Place the egg pancake in the center and add red pepper paste and sesame oil..
4. Mix well and enjoy..

Recipes: Langmyeon
material: buckwheat noodles, Dongchimi water, cucumber, ship, boiled eggs, vinegar, mustard, sugar.
Cooking method:
1. Boil buckwheat noodles in boiling water and rinse in cold water to make sari..
2. Season the cooled Dongchimi water with vinegar and sugar..
3. Put the sari in a bowl, pour the broth, and add cucumbers., ship, Add eggs.
4. Serve with mustard on the side..

Recipes: dumpling soup
material: ten dumplings, bone broth, Kim, egg crust, green onion, garlic.
Cooking method:
1. Boil the beef bone broth until thick..
2. Add the dumplings to the boiling broth and cook until they float..
3. Place the dumplings in a bowl and pour the broth..
4. seaweed powder, egg crust, Finish with chopped green onions..

We recommend today’s meal.
morning: White rice and seaweed soup, Seasoned bean sprouts, Serve with kimchi.
lunch: If you eat bibimbap with soybean paste soup and raw radish vegetables, you will be well nourished..
dinner: It is good to eat cold noodles with two or three dumplings and dongchimi..
Snacks include rice cake and sikhye., Or I recommend corn..

Recipes: stewed pollack
material: Two pollack, half a radish, Two spoons of red pepper paste, soy sauce, garlic, green onion, red pepper powder, water.
Cooking method:
1. Wash the pollack thoroughly and cut it into pieces..
2. Chop the radish thickly and spread it on the bottom of the pot..
3. Put pollack on top and add seasoning sauce..
4. Pour in a little water and simmer over medium heat..
5. Lastly, top with chopped green onions..

Recipes: Bean sprout soup
material: A bag of bean sprouts, Five cups of anchovy broth, Minced garlic, Cheongyang pepper, salt.
Cooking method:
1. Wash the bean sprouts thoroughly under running water..
2. When the anchovy broth boils, add bean sprouts, cover and boil..
3. Do not open the lid frequently while boiling to avoid fishy smell..
4. Add minced garlic and finely chopped Cheongyang pepper and season with salt..

Recipes: potato pancake
material: three potatoes, A handful of chives, salt, cooking oil.
Cooking method:
1. Grate the potatoes finely and squeeze out the moisture..
2. Mix the chopped chives and season with salt..
3. Put cooking oil on a heated griddle and pour out the dough, one spoonful at a time..
4. Once both sides are golden brown, serve on a plate..

Recipes: Spinach salad
material: A bunch of spinach, Chopped green onion, Minced garlic, sesame oil, Sesame salt, soy sauce.
Cooking method:
1. Trim the spinach and lightly blanch it in boiling water..
2. Rinse in cold water and squeeze out excess water..
3. Make the seasoning sauce and gently season it with the spinach..
4. Finish by sprinkling sesame salt..
